model.effort: API default (this endpoint sends none): haiku/opus medium, sonnet high (rank C)
model.temperature: not sent (wilco drop_body_keys); the endpoint samples, so sits are samples, not loads
model.load_protocol: 'load' = one sit: every case once, sequentially, one process; hosted, so no weights are loaded and n_unstable counts sampling disagreement between sits

prices.source: claude-api reference model table, cached 2026-10-06 (rank C); the same rates wilco's docs/probes/frontier-direct-2026-10-28 used
prices.tier: standard, no prompt caching, no batch

wilco.grader: sandbox/runner.py run_exam (per case, provider='anthropic'), adapter_for -> lab.hosted.MeteredHosted around router.get_adapter('anthropic')
wilco.snapshot_rule: sandbox/runner.py aggregate_loads: majority verdict over sits, stable = all agree
wilco.tier: agents say tier: local; lifted for this lane by the operator's go (synthetic public cases)

energy_note: hosted: no local energy to meter; cost is $ from metered tokens x list price
